//: Associate Galacticus parameter files with the parameter XSD so the Red Hat XML extension (redhat.vscode-xml) gives real-time validation and autocompletion. The schema in .vscode/schema/parameters.xsd is a vendored snapshot of schema/parameters.xsd from the Galacticus repository (regenerate with tutorial/../scripts if it drifts). Open a file under tutorial/parameters/ and start typing an element name to see the schema at work.
